source_evaluations.name: Government of Maharashtra State Portal
source_evaluations.notes: Main state government portal. Provides general notices and policy links; no public REST API.

source_evaluations.name: Maharashtra Government Resolutions (GR) Repository
source_evaluations.notes: ASP.NET WebForms portal requiring VIEWSTATE session state. No public REST/RSS feed.

source_evaluations.name: MahaDBT (Direct Benefit Transfer) Portal
source_evaluations.notes: Citizen authentication and scholarship portal. Does not provide an unauthenticated open query API.

source_evaluations.name: MahaDBT Secondary/Legacy Gateway
source_evaluations.notes: SSL handshake timeout observed during automated probing; marked as unstable/unavailable.

disclaimer: Curated from official Government Resolutions (GRs), notifications, and official portals of the Government of Maharashtra. This source-backed registry provides verified ground-truth baselines and does not claim to index every scheme in Maharashtra.

schemes.department_en: Women and Child Development Department, Government of Maharashtra
schemes.department_mr: महिला व बाल विकास विभाग, महाराष्ट्र शासन
schemes.benefit_amount_description_en: ₹1,500 per month (direct benefit transfer to Aadhaar-linked bank account)
schemes.benefit_amount_description_mr: दरमहा ₹१,५०० (आधार लिंक बँक खात्यात थेट जमा)
official_application_channels_en: Official Nari Shakti Doot Mobile Application
In-person at Anganwadi Kendra, Gram Panchayat, or Setu Suvidha Kendra
official_application_channels_mr: अंगणवाडी केंद्र, ग्रामपंचायत किंवा सेतू सुविधा केंद्र येथे प्रत्यक्ष अर्ज
known_scam_conflicts: Claims promising ₹3,000, ₹5,000, or ₹10,000 monthly payouts (official amount is strictly ₹1,500)
Claims asking citizens to register by clicking an unverified WhatsApp link or bit.ly link
Claims asking citizens to download an APK file (e.g. Ladki_Bahin_Form.apk) outside the Google Play Store
Demands for registration fees or processing charges (the official application is 100% free)

schemes.benefit_amount_description_en: ₹6,000 annually per eligible farmer (paid in 3 installments of ₹2,000 each, supplemental to PM-KISAN)
schemes.benefit_amount_description_mr: वार्षिक ₹६,००० प्रति शेतकरी (₹२,००० चे ३ हप्ते, पीएम-किसान योजनेव्यतिरिक्त)
official_application_channels_en: Integrated automatically with verified PM-KISAN database
official_application_channels_mr: पीएम-किसान पोर्टलवरील पडताळणीकृत शेतकरी यादीनुसार थेट लाभ
known_scam_conflicts: Demands for advance registration fees or KYC release fees
Claims offering ₹10,000 or ₹15,000 one-time lump-sum transfers
Requests to share OTP or ATM PIN with WhatsApp contacts to unblock installment

schemes.department_en: Social Justice and Special Assistance Department / Directorate of Higher Education
schemes.department_mr: सामाजिक न्याय व विशेष सहाय्य विभाग / उच्च शिक्षण संचालनालय
schemes.benefit_amount_description_en: Tuition fee reimbursement, exam fees, and maintenance allowance as per student category and course norms
schemes.benefit_amount_description_mr: अभ्यासक्रम व संवर्ग नियमांनुसार शैक्षणिक शुल्क प्रतिपूर्ती व निर्वाह भत्ता
official_application_channels_en: Strictly via student login on the official portal (mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in)
official_application_channels_mr: केवळ अधिकृत महाडीबीटी पोर्टलवर (mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in) विद्यार्थी लॉगिनद्वारे
known_scam_conflicts: Messages claiming scholarship has arrived and asking user to enter UPI PIN to claim money
Links leading to non-gov domains (e.g. mahadbt-scholarship-update.xyz)

schemes.department_en: Social Justice and Special Assistance Department, Government of Maharashtra
schemes.department_mr: सामाजिक न्याय व विशेष सहाय्य विभाग, महाराष्ट्र शासन
schemes.benefit_amount_description_en: One-time financial assistance of ₹3,000 directly deposited for senior citizens (aged 65+) to purchase daily-living assistive aids
schemes.benefit_amount_description_mr: ६५ वर्षे किंवा त्यावरील ज्येष्ठ नागरिकांना दैनंदिन जीवन सुलभ साधनांसाठी एकरकमी ₹३,०००
official_application_channels_en: Gram Panchayat / Municipal Corporation facilitation counters
Authorized Setu Suvidha Kendra (Offline form submission)
known_scam_conflicts: Claims promising monthly pensions of ₹5,000 or ₹10,000 under Vayoshri
Directing elderly citizens to install an APK file on their phone to receive the money

schemes.department_mr: ऊर्जा विभाग / महाराष्ट्र राज्य विद्युत वितरण कंपनी मर्यादित (महावितरण)
